pluginText.pf.license: {"need":"none for laundry, wash and fold or dry cleaning in most places; the business registration, where the state asks for one; a dry cleaner that uses cleaning solvents holds the environmental registration or permit the state's rules require (solvent use and waste)","ask":["The business registration number, where the state gave one","For dry cleaning with solvents: the environmental registration or permit number, where the state's rules require one","Proof of business auto insurance, for pickup and delivery"],"who":"the business; no license for a person","check":"none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie","blocks":"a registration or permit the state requires that the owner says the business lacks keeps that kind of work offline; wash and fold can go live on its registration alone","renewals":"optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)","insurance":"liability insurance and cover for customers' garments while the shop has them, as the business says; shown only once proof is sent","otherwise":"identity checked, and 'license: what the business says'; customers see no license claim"}

for a pickup, the saved card is charged when the order is delivered"},{"name":"Dry cleaning, per item","price":"shirt laundered and pressed $3.50, pants or skirt $8, jacket $9, 2-piece suit $17, dress from $14 (the example shop's own prices); leather and suede can be priced from photos first","kind":"quoted at the visit","before":"nothing taken","after":"at the counter at pick-up"},{"name":"Wedding gown cleaning","price":"$140 for a standard gown; heavy beading, a long train or a preservation box is quoted at the counter first","length":"4 to 6 weeks","before":"a $40 deposit books the slot","after":"the $100 rest at pick-up"},{"name":"Stain check","price":"free, at the counter","length":"while you wait","before":"nothing taken","after":"nothing"},{"name":"Pickup and delivery","price":"free over $30; $5.99 under $30, inside the order total shown before the yes","place":"at the customer's door, in a 2-hour window; bags left out; returned within 48 hours","before":"a card saved, no fee","after":"the saved card charged for the ticket total when the order is delivered","note":"one time, or every week or 2 weeks on one chosen day (a repeat plan; pluginText.pf.questions: {"before_times":["Drop-off at the counter, or pickup at the door","Wash and fold, dry cleaning, comforters or blankets, or a mix","About how many pounds or items","The date it's needed back, like an event (it sets which turnaround fits)","For a pickup: the town and the kind of place, a house or an apartment with a doorman","Any item soaked in gasoline, oil or thinner, with blood, or holding needles or sharp things: those stay out of the bag"],"after_time":["Detergent: regular, fragrance-free or hypoallergenic; fabric softener or not","Folded or on hangers; starch on shirts","Any stain the customer knows about: what and where","Items that need special care, like silk, wool or leather"],"secure_page_only":["The street address, the door or doorman instructions and any building code","A skin or allergy reason for fragrance-free (the preference itself isn't private)","The card"],"who_may_book":"an adult, for themselves or their household; a parent books for a child's clothes"}
pluginText.pf.safety: {"stop_words":[],"stop_action":"no danger words of its own: the generic screen (danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency, crisis words) is always on","refuse_items":"clothes or rags soaked in gasoline, oil, paint thinner or cooking oil (they can catch fire in a dryer, even on their own); blood, body fluids or waste beyond normal wear; needles or sharp items; the AI asks the customer to keep them out of the bag; the plant sets any found aside, unwashed, and the owner calls","pests":"bed bugs or lice: only in sealed bags, declared ahead; a $20 handling fee (example); an undeclared infested bag is set aside and the owner calls","pockets":"pockets are checked; cash and items found come back with the order; a lighter or a needle is set aside","can_continue":"yes, for the rest of the order, after the item is set aside"}
pluginText.pf.first_steps: {"required":"none for a drop-off; for a pickup: the door instructions on the secure page","prep_for_reminder":["Bag your laundry and empty the pockets","List any stains on the secure page","For a pickup: leave the bags at the door by the start of the window"]}
pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"at the counter: the check-in code, or a walk-in checked in at once; at the door: the driver scans the bag tag and takes a photo of the bags, and nobody needs to be home","intake":"each item counted and tagged; wash and fold weighed in front of the customer (at the plant for a pickup); stains, tears, missing buttons and wear noted, with photos of any item at risk; an itemized ticket is texted with the total; a count that differs from the customer's is told the same day","estimate":"special items are priced before cleaning, and the customer says yes; no yes in 24 hours: the item is left uncleaned and comes back with the order, with nothing charged for it","added_work":"a repair, extra stain work or special cleaning found later is priced first and needs the customer's yes; no answer in 24 hours: cleaned the normal way, without the extra","over_weight":"a pickup order weighed more than 10 pounds over what the customer said: the new total is texted first and needs a yes; no answer in 24 hours: only the pounds the customer said are washed, and the rest comes back unwashed","ready":"READY is texted with the pick-up hours and the total; a pickup order is delivered in its window, with a photo","pick_up":"anyone with the claim ticket or the code may pick up; a delivery is left at the door or with the doorman","done_proof":"DONE at pick-up at the counter, or at delivery with the door photo","claims":"a damaged or missing item is reported within 7 days of pick-up or delivery (the shop's rule); the owner decides with the industry's fair-claims guide (the item's age and condition), never more than the item's value","unclaimed":"items not picked up: reminders at 30 and 60 days after READY, then a final written notice with the date before anything is donated at 90 days, as the state's unclaimed-property rules allow; the owner decides"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"drop-off: nothing taken; wedding gown cleaning: a $40 deposit books the slot; pickup and delivery: a card saved to book, with no fee","deposit":"the $40 gown deposit comes off the price; the rest is paid at pick-up; deposit cap: from the state form","after":"drop-off: paid at the counter at pick-up; pickup and delivery: the saved card is charged the ticket total when the order is delivered, never before; a business account may be billed after delivery instead","fees":"no late-cancel or no-show fee; no bags out at a pickup: no fee, and the next pickup stays as planned","delivery":"free over $30, $5.99 under $30; part of the order total shown before the yes","rush":"same day +$10 when dropped by 9am, shown in the price before the yes","tips":"no tip line","tax":"where the state's rules tax laundry or dry cleaning (the owner's setting)","rosfield_2":"Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies; a repeat pickup plan paid by the visit pays $2 a visit"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never_in_text":["A card number","A building or door code","A skin or allergy reason for fragrance-free"],"staff_texts":"driver texts name the customer, the street, the window and the number of bags; the door instructions open on the secure link","languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"texts about a child's clothes go to the parent who booked"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"skills":["counter","wash and fold","spotting (stain work)","pressing","driving"],"licenses":"none for a person; drivers hold a valid driver's license, and the business's auto insurance covers them","supervision":"solvents are handled only by trained staff, under the shop's safety rules","who_oks":"the owner OKs claims, refunds and special-item prices over $100","stand_in":"any driver on the route may do a pickup; any counter staff may take a drop-off; nobody is booked by name"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"environment":"solvent and waste rules for dry cleaning where the state's rules apply (the business's own)","unclaimed_items":"switch: how long finished items are held, the written notice, and the waiting time before they're donated or sold: from the state form; the owner decides, and Rosie sends only the notices the owner OKs","claims":"the shop's posted claims policy; never a value above the item's","prices":"switch: prices posted where the state's or local rules require it; the same price for like items where those rules require it","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"applies":["A count that differs from the customer's: told the same day; a missing item is searched for 7 days, then the owner decides","A stain that stays: noted on the ticket; no charge for a second try","A damaged item: the owner decides with the claims policy","No bags out at a pickup: the driver takes a photo of the door; no fee; the next pickup as planned","Snow or a closed road: a delivery may move to the next day; the customer is told","A planned closure, like a holiday: repeat pickups skip that day, with notice","A wrong order: swapped the same day","A need-by date: only turnarounds that make it are offered","An item not picked up: reminders at 30 and 60 days; a final notice before the 90-day donation","An item that can't go in the bag, found at the plant: set aside, unwashed, and the owner calls"],"handling":"each the generic way, with the plug-in's words; the owner decides every claim and refund"}

The door photo is the after record. Alex can report a problem within 7 days.
It's the same booking: no new code and no new $2.
Snow or a closed road: the delivery may move to the next day, and Alex is told first.
